last.verdict: Record bookings and a profit-forecast raise sent the stock sharply higher.

reasons.label: Record 2027 demand
reasons.text: 2027 is about half booked, with record occupancy and pricing; 2028 bookings also ahead of last year.

reasons.label: Profit forecast raised
reasons.text: Full-year earnings forecast rose to about $2.24 a share from $2.22, despite fuel costs.

reasons.label: Beat on record quarter
reasons.text: Quarterly earnings of $1.43 a share beat the roughly $1.35 expected, on record $8.44 billion revenue.

story: Carnival's earlier 2026 reports each beat estimates but sent the stock lower, as higher fuel costs forced guidance cuts in March and a weak outlook in June. This report finally paired a forecast raise with record bookings, and the shares rebounded.
